pitch:
Little Shore Play Cafe, a calm, clean, Montessori-inspired play cafe for kids 8 months to 5, opening in Salisbury, MD next year.
Birthday parties: 2 hours in our private glass party room plus time in the play village.
Basic, $325: up to 12 kids, a party host who sets up and cleans up, invitations, plates and napkins, juice for kids and coffee for adults.
Premium, $425: up to 20 kids, adds a cafe platter (fruit, cheese, mini sandwiches) and a hosted craft or story activity.
All-in pricing: no auto-gratuity, no card fees, no surprise charges. You bring the cake. Saturday and Sunday slots at 10am, 1pm and 4pm.
